_status: ASSUMPTIONS, not regulation. Placeholder norms for estimating generation from mapped buildings. Calibrate with a ward waste characterisation survey, BBMP/GBA weighbridge data and CPCB BWG norms once issued (SWM Rules 2026, r. 6(e)).

household._sources: kg/capita and persons/dwelling are typical Bengaluru metro estimates.

non_residential._unit: kg per day per 100 m2 of floor area

mixed_use._rule: Ground floor treated as the commercial use found inside the building; upper floors as residential dwellings.

stream_shares._note: Share of each building's waste by stream (wet, dry, sanitary, special care). Rows sum to 1.

dry_waste_fractions._note: Assumed split of dry waste into fractions for MRF sorting. SWM Rules 2026 r. 3(1)(zw) names paper including paperboard, plastic, metal, glass etc.; wood and rubber are also sorted at MRFs. 'other_and_rejects' covers textiles, multi-layer packaging and inert rejects.

per_unit._note: Typology rates per surveyed unit, kg/day. Used when a surveyor records the number of units. Residential units use the household norm. Replace with weighed data when available.

surveyed_use._note: How a surveyor's building use maps to a typology when OSM does not already give a finer one.

_water: Water use is not estimated. The BWG water criterion (40,000 L/day) is checked only against surveyor input or BWSSB billing data.
